name: Hyatt Regency Nha Trang
short_description: Hyatt's first Nha Trang property, a 434-room beachfront hotel on Tran Phu Street across from the bay, opened December 2025 with a Regency Club and ocean-view suites.
ai_summary: Hyatt Regency Nha Trang opened December 28, 2025 as Hyatt's first hotel in Nha Trang, on Tran Phu Street in the city centre directly across from the beach and within walking distance of the night market. All 434 guest rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies facing Nha Trang Bay or the city. An early Globalist review praises the beachfront views, a spacious 76-square-metre suite with dual balconies, a strong breakfast buffet, and a Regency Club with panoramic glass walls and evening canapes, while noting the pool can be unusable on windy days, breakfast variety thins out over a longer stay, and the property doesn't participate in the Hyatt Prive premium tier.

pros: Hyatt's first hotel in Nha Trang, opened December 28, 2025, directly across from the beach on Tran Phu Street
All 434 rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies facing the bay or city
Regency Club has floor-to-ceiling glass walls with panoramic views and evening canapes
Well-executed Vietnamese and international breakfast buffet with a live noodle station
Walking distance to Nha Trang's night market and promenade
cons: The pool's high-altitude exposure can make it unusable on windy days
Breakfast menu rotation thins out after several consecutive days
Does not participate in the Hyatt Prive premium-tier program
As a December 2025 opening, it has a very short guest-review track record so far
research_highlights: An early Globalist review calls the suite and Regency Club experience genuinely impressive for a brand-new property
The beachfront Tran Phu Street location and bay views are consistently praised
Staff attentiveness toward World of Hyatt elite members stands out in early reviews
research_watchouts: Windy conditions can make the pool unusable, worth checking before booking a pool-focused stay
As a newly opened hotel, review volume and long-term consistency are still limited

faqs.question: When did Hyatt Regency Nha Trang open?
faqs.answer: December 28, 2025, as Hyatt's first hotel in Nha Trang -- a beachfront property on Tran Phu Street in the city centre, directly across from the beach and within walking distance of the night market.

faqs.question: Does Hyatt Regency Nha Trang have a Regency Club lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the Regency Club features floor-to-ceiling glass walls with panoramic bay views and evening canapes, available to suite guests and World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members.
